subject.title: feat: add opt-in telemetry for native chat lifecycle

question: Should the tray adopt this seven-span chat lifecycle taxonomy, associated metrics, and terminal-reason model as a supported observability contract before cross-process gateway trace propagation exists?
rationale: Tests and proof can validate the implementation, but only maintainers can accept the long-term signal names, lifecycle semantics, and intentionally separate gateway trace as product policy.

options.title: Accept the contract
options.body: Merge the current low-cardinality taxonomy and track gateway trace-context propagation separately.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Keep only turn, send, response-wait, and response-receive signals while deferring history, queue, and drop diagnostics.

options.title: Wait for end-to-end tracing
options.body: Pause native chat telemetry until the gateway protocol can propagate W3C trace context across processes.

recommendation.title: Accept the contract
recommendation.body: Merge the current low-cardinality taxonomy and track gateway trace-context propagation separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is repeated ownership of tray diagnostics, WinUI tests, and core companion behavior.
